endorsements.name: Big Tiger
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-0209
endorsements.description: The Mitsol Social Post Feed WordPress plugin before 1.11 does not escape some of its settings before outputting them back in attributes, which could allow high privilege users such as admin to perform cross-Site Scripting attacks even when the unfiltered_html capability is disallowed
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Big Tiger
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-0210
endorsements.description: The Random Banner WordPress plugin is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting due to insufficient escaping via the category parameter found in the ~/include/models/model.php file which allowed attackers with administrative user access to inject arbitrary web scripts, in versions up to and including 4.1.4. This affects multi-site installations where unfiltered_html is disabled for administrators, and sites where unfiltered_html is disabled.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.8)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.label: CVE-2022-0232

endorsements.name: Big Tiger
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-0233
endorsements.description: The ProfileGrid – User Profiles, Memberships, Groups and Communities WordPress plugin is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting due to insufficient escaping via the pm_user_avatar and pm_cover_image parameters found in the ~/admin/class-profile-magic-admin.php file which allows attackers with authenticated user access, such as subscribers, to inject arbitrary web scripts into their profile, in versions up to and including 1.2.7.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.4)
